base: p_c^site(Z^3) <= 1/2 (Campanino and Russo, Ann. Probab. 13 (1985) 478-491), used as theta(501/1000) > 0
rule: G = largest open component; ties: larger sum over faces of face-site counts, then first found in site order; empty if fewer than 6 sites
checks_per_link: root: r_f(full face) >= q for 6 faces; 3066 entry laws (6 faces x 511 nonempty entry sets) x 7579 nontrivial up-sets of {0,1}^5, exact integer comparison after outward-rounded interval sums
